description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the BLEU score and the length of the gold prefix for two different conditions in simultaneous machine translation: one represented by a blue dashed line with circle markers, and the other by a red solid line with square markers labeled “Inconsistency: wait-9.” The x-axis, labeled “the length of gold prefix,” ranges from 0 to 20 with integer tick marks at every 5 units. The y-axis, labeled “BLEU,” spans from 23 to 29 with major gridlines at every 1 unit. The blue line begins at approximately BLEU 24.7 at prefix length 0, dips to about 23.8 at length 1, then gradually increases to around 28.1 at length 20, showing a generally upward trend with minor fluctuations. The red line starts at BLEU 25.1 at length 0, rises to a peak of about 26.0 near length 6, then declines slightly and stabilizes between 25.0 and 25.5 from length 10 to 19, ending at approximately 25.9 at length 20. Both lines show that BLEU generally improves with longer gold prefixes, though the blue condition consistently outperforms the red one after prefix length 5.
